item.title: All Creative Work Is Derivative (Nina Paley)
item.description: Nina Paley’s short animation, made entirely from photographs of sculptures at the Metropolitan Museum of Art, arguing that all creative work builds on what came before.

item.title: From Zero to Creative Hero in Five Steps (Instagram Reel)
item.description: Five-step framework for creative growth from an Instagram reel; pinned here mainly as a reminder to read the two books on rhetoric it recommends.

item.title: Spinoza, Einstein, and the Illusion of Free Will (Avshalom Elitzur)
item.description: Avshalom Elitzur on Spinoza’s denial of free will, Einstein’s love for him, and the paradox of believing in political freedom while doubting metaphysical free will.
